prompt:
Research the officially documented limits of Supabase's free plan (database size, monthly active users, file storage, project pausing). Cite Supabase's own page and quote the limits.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on the search results, here are the officially documented limits for Supabase's Free Plan.

**Database Size:**
The free plan includes 500 MB of database size per project. It's important to distinguish between *disk size* and *database size*; the free plan's 500 MB limit is on the actual Postgres data size.

SOURCE: https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/database-size | QUOTE: "Free Plan projects enter read-only mode when your database size exceeds 500 MB." | CLAIM: The free plan has a 500 MB database size limit.
SOURCE: https://supabase.com/pricing | QUOTE: "500 MB database size per project included" | CLAIM: The free plan includes 500 MB of database size per project.
SOURCE: https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/billing-on-supabase | QUOTE: "Database Size: 500 MB per project" | CLAIM: The free plan includes 500 MB of database size per project.

**Monthly Active Users (MAU):**
The free plan includes 50,000 monthly active users.

SOURCE: https://supabase.com/pricing | QUOTE: "50,000 monthly active users" | CLAIM: The free plan includes 50,000 monthly active users.
SOURCE: https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/billing-on-supabase | QUOTE: "Monthly Active Users: 50,000 MAU" | CLAIM: The free plan includes 50,000 monthly active users.

**File Storage:**
The free plan includes 1 GB of file storage.

SOURCE: https://supabase.com/pricing | QUOTE: "1 GB file storage" | CLAIM: The free plan includes 1 GB of file storage.
SOURCE: https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/billing-on-supabase | QUOTE: "Storage Size: 1 GB" | CLAIM: The free plan includes 1 GB of storage.

**Project Pausing:**
Free projects are automatically paused after 1 week of inactivity. However, users can also manually pause and unpause projects at any time. A user is entitled to have two active free projects simultaneously, but an unlimited number of paused projects.

SOURCE: https://supabase.com/pricing | QUOTE: "Free projects are paused after 1 week of inactivity." | CLAIM: Free projects are automatically paused after 1 week of inactivity.
SOURCE: https://supabase.com/pricing | QUOTE: "Yes, you can pause a project at any time. Our Free Plan gives you 2 free projects, but you can have as many paused projects as you want." | CLAIM: Users can manually pause projects and have an unlimited number of paused projects.
SOURCE: https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/billing-faq | QUOTE: "You are entitled to two active free projects. Paused projects do not count towards your quota." | CLAIM: The limit is on active projects; paused projects do not count towards the two-project limit.
